topic: Setting up a home exercise corner

slides.headline: A corner, a mat and five minutes
slides.sub: Set up a small home exercise space you'll actually use this year.

slides.title: Pick a spot you walk past
slides.body: Next to the kettle, beside the bed or in front of the TV. Visible beats hidden. If you have to dig the mat out of a cupboard first, it becomes much easier to skip.

slides.title: Five things cover most programs
slides.body: A mat, a resistance band, a sturdy chair or step, a couple of light weights (a backpack with books works) and a clear patch of wall. Pricey equipment isn't required.

slides.title: Make it ready to go
slides.body: Leave the mat rolled beside the spot, hang the band on a hook and stick your exercise sheet at eye level. Fewer steps between you and starting makes a surprising difference.

slides.title: Anchor it to a habit
slides.body: Pair your exercises with something you already do: after the morning coffee, while dinner's in the oven. Two short sessions you actually do beat one long session you keep putting off.

slides.title: Make it safe first
slides.body: Clear trip hazards, use a non-slip surface, put the chair against a wall and check any door anchor is secure. If an exercise causes sharp or increasing pain, stop and ask your practitioner.

slides.headline: Want exercises for your corner?
slides.body: Our team at Hybrid Physiotherapy can build a short home program around the space and gear you already have. Book online — link in bio.

caption:
A corner, a mat and five minutes. That's a home gym.

Home exercises are much easier to do when the setup is already waiting for you. Pick a spot you walk past every day, keep the gear visible and stick your exercise sheet at eye level.

Most home programs only need a mat, a resistance band, a sturdy chair, a couple of light weights (a backpack with books works) and some wall space. Pair your session with a habit you already have, like the morning coffee, and keep it short.

Clear trip hazards and stop any exercise that causes sharp or increasing pain.

Want a program built for your space? Book online via the link in bio.

story.headline: Set up your corner today
story.body: Mat down, band on a hook, exercise sheet at eye level. Then do one exercise.
